name: Serena Shigar Fort (Fong-Khar)
description: A 400-year-old Raja's fort meticulously restored by the Aga Khan Trust for Culture. Combines ancient Tibetan woodwork with authentic mountain luxury.

name: Luxus Grand Attabad Lake Resort
description: Suspended on the rocky cliffs directly overlooking the electric-turquoise waters of Attabad Lake. Perfect for romantic post-climb relaxation.

name: Raikot Sarai Pine Alpine Cabins
description: Rustic, handcrafted pine log cabins with private verandas looking directly up at the 8,126-meter icy ramparts of Nanga Parbat.

name: Concordia Geodesic Glacier Basecamp
facilities: Heated Mess Tent with Gas Heaters
description: A fortified, high-altitude mobile campsite pitched directly on the glacial ice of Concordia, flanked by K2, Broad Peak, and Gasherbrum IV.

name: Hornlihutte Alpine Base
description: Perched at the base of the Hornli Ridge on the Matterhorn. The staging post for all climbers departing at 4:00 AM for the summit ridge.
